hook: A 1971 horror drama banned for decades returns in 4K.

sections.voiceover: A 1971 horror drama banned for decades returns in 4K.
sections.visual_cue: Vintage poster of The Devils fades into a 4K screen.

sections.voiceover: On October 30, 2026, BFI Distribution and Warner Bros. Clockwork released the 4K restoration. The film stars Oliver Reed and Vanessa Redgrave as Urbain Grandier. How many years was it banned before 2026?
sections.visual_cue: Timeline graphic showing October 30, 2026 release, then faces of Reed and Redgrave.

sections.voiceover: Yet the film vanished from screens for over fifty years.
sections.visual_cue: Shadowed cinema seats empty, overlaid with a 50‑year timeline.

sections.voiceover: The restored cut runs 114 minutes, preserving Ken Russell’s unflinching vision. Censors hid it for over fifty years, muting its brutal 17th‑century hysteria. Now audiences in the UK and Ireland can finally witness the masterpiece.
sections.visual_cue: Clips of the restored film playing in a modern theater, UK and Ireland flags appear.

sections.voiceover: The Devils finally returns, restored in full 4K glory.
sections.visual_cue: The Devils title card shines in crisp 4K resolution.
